newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Kwoon Chung shares fall after debut jump.
newsitem.headline: Kwoon Chung shares fall after debut jump.

text.p: Shares of Kwoon Chung Bus Holdings Ltd fell on Thursday, their second trading day, on profit-taking after Wednesday's debut jump, brokers said.

"Speculation of a limited upside after its jump triggered profit-taking interest, especially as the company's China ventures are seen taking time before contributing to earnings," said a sales manager at a regional brokerage.

The shares fell HK$0.15 or 6.38 percent to HK$2.20 at midday on volume of 13.19 million shares. Shares of the bus operator rose HK$0.55 or 31 percent on Wednesday from their issue price to end at HK$2.35. -- Hong Kong Newsroom (852) 2843 6370
